gitCommit.body:
fix(canvas): filter out soft-deleted canvases in all data/action queries (#1465)

Previously, getCanvasDraftById and several canvas action functions did not
check `deletedAt: null`, allowing deleted canvases to be accessed via URL
and modified via save/rename/tag/duplicate operations.
